## Describe the bug

A clear, concise description of what's wrong.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Go to '...'
2. Call '...' (include the exact request, e.g. `POST /api/v1/interviews/`)
3. See error

## Expected behavior

What you expected to happen instead.

## Actual behavior

What actually happened. Include the exact error message/response body if
applicable (redact any secrets, tokens, or personal data first).

## Environment

- Component: [backend / frontend / docker / CI]
- OS:
- Python version (if backend):
- Node version (if frontend):
